title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday! 2023〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka, happy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: ...birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Though the actual day is tomorrow... This feels like a pre-celebration of sorts.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You'll be doing a birthday livestream for Haruka tomorrow, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! That's also exactly why I suggested we celebrate today with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We will also be celebrating with our friends from school on the weekend. It seems like this week is going to be so lively.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel somewhat bad for all of this. You really didn't need to put on so many celebrations for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Absolutely not. It is our complete pleasure! Also, the day you were born into this world is a very important event for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If anything, it's so important that this should be a month of national holidays!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your love for her is over the top as always...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I'm glad that we were able to celebrate Haruka's birthday all together like this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll be doing bingo after this, won't we? Ever since you told us, I've been fidgeting in excitement. I can't wait to try it out♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! I brought the bingo machine me and my family used when I was a kid!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's so cute. I didn't know there were bingo machines this small.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right. But its size makes it so much easier to take out and play anytime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I've prepared some luxurious prices for first, second and third place, so I hope you're all excited.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oooh! Luxurious prizes?! I wonder what they are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we need someone to operate the machine, right? That means one person won't be able to participate...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why I decided that I'll be the host of this. Besides, I already know what the prizes are, and if I end up getting bingo first it'll be a little awkward...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's get this show on the road. I'll be handing out the bingo sheets, so please take whichever one you'd like! But remember, each sheet will determine your fate, so you may want to choose carefully!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: F-f-f-fi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Finally! I only have one number away from bingo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, congrats, Minori!
Is what I'd like to say, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're the last one to get there. Actually, everyone already got there... Shizuku on the other hand is on her way to a triple bingo if Lady Luck shines on her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Waaaah! But the numbers just never lined up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well bingo is all about luck.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But at least you managed to catch up before anyone was able to get bingo, Minori. It's going to be more exciting now. Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you! With you cheering me on, I have a feeling I'll get all of the numbers and punch out the whole sheet!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't think that would be bingo anymore...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But ever since Shizuku got three lines ready for bingo, none of her numbers have come up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's true... I wonder why. Things were going so well at the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But having three lines is amazing! I'm still at only one line!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since anyone could get bingo now, the next number might determine the winner!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right! I was last to get to this point but I might be lucky enough to win in the end!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm going to wish as much as I can right now! Please, all-powerful beings of the universe and the Goddess Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't think sending me your wish will do you any good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, let's roll again!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, the number that'll determine the winner...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Is here!
Number... 105!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? 105?! That means...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh. Bingo.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? You too, Haruka?! I got bingo too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So that means Minori and Haruka got bingo at the same time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Actually, about that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also got bingo with 105.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whaaat! You too, Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow! Congratulations, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To think that three people would get bingo at the same time. I wasn't expecting that, but a kinda funny turn of events.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But, what do we do about the prizes? You prepared them based on who would get what place, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course, we'll be giving Haruka first prize! She's the star of the day after all♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? That doesn't seem right.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's absolutely fine! It's your birthday bingo, and more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The number that got you bingo was 105! The very date of your birthday! Did any of you guys notice?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Now that you mention it, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Therefore, without a doubt, first place must go to Haruka! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Without a doubt? Must?
I don't know about that but if you all say so, then I'll kindly take it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone.
song00004_off_f
Haruka's birthday
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that is how...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka won a massage gun that helps you loosen up your muscles at her birthday party yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Congrats on getting first prize at your birthday party bingo!>
<Getting bingo with 105 is so much more of a win than getting first place!>
<I want a massage gun too! Everyone's getting one lately>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Seems like a lot of people know massage guns too. I actually really wanted one myself, so I'm glad I got it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I always use a foam roller to release tension around my muscles but I'm definitely going to use this massage gun to do that now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Seems like it'll take your muscle training to the next level.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're done with the chit-chat, let's move on to the main event!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today's stream will be all about celebrating Haruka's birthday! We'll be accepting all of your happy birthday comments, so don't hold back!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Haruka!>
<I'm forever grateful for the day you were born!>
<I made a birthday shrine for you! It's up on SNS if you wanna have a look!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you, everyone.
It makes me so happy to receive so many birthday messages. I'm going to take my time to read each and every one of them.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<OMG, Haruka's birthday smile is just too bright!>
<My letter is super long but I hope you'll get to read it!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you the one smiling in happiness?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because everyone is wishing Haruka a happy birthday and as a fan myself, it makes me so, so, so happy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, you're being dramatic.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I totally feel the same as Minori. It makes me happy too>
<I couldn't help but smile during the birthday bingo story>
<I love that you have so many friends, Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, Haruka does have a lot of friends. We'll actually be having another birthday party with some of our other friends this weekend.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<OMG! Really?!?>
<I wanna be friends and celebrate your birthday with you too, Haruka!>
<What are you guys gonna do? Bingo again?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't think we'll be playing bingo again, but I actually still don't know where we'll be going.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because it'll be a surprise! I hope you're looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Is it okay to tell her that? lol>
<Throwing three birthday parties? You're all so close!>
<Hope you have fun, Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'm already so happy to receive all of your birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, some of you said that I have a lot of friends but... It's not because I'm special or anything. It's really because everyone around me is so kind and sweet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You all can tell just from watching our streams, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So true! You girls really are close!>
<Everyone's so nice that it's impossible to have a fav!>
<That's why MMJ is my fav!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, see? Of course, I appreciate all of my friends, but I also always appreciate each and every one of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for everything. I'll let you all know how the birthday party on the weekend goes in a different stream. Hope to see you then.
